summary.zh: agent-pack：项目或 HOME 的路径里含 credential、secret、token 等字样时，sync --client claude 不再把启动器的 --env-file 路径误判为疑似密钥；令牌形的参数值仍然阻塞且不回显。
summary.en: agent-pack: paths containing words such as credential, secret or token (project or HOME directory) no longer make sync --client claude reject the launcher's --env-file path as a possible secret; token-shaped argument values are still blocked and never echoed.
